title: Review of the Pebble Index 01 AI Ring
excerpt: A review of the Pebble Index 01 AI ring examines its low-tech build, affordable price, and singular focus on a single useful feature.
body_html:
A new review looks at the Pebble Index 01 AI ring, highlighting its minimalist design and focused functionality.

The device is described as cheap and low-tech while serving a single purpose. Despite its simplicity, the review notes that the wearable proves to be very useful in practice.
